title: Composer
summary: The text field at the bottom of a chat: Markdown text, @ mentions in groups, a draft kept per chat, and the entries to attachments, stickers and voice. It replaces the draft and send of chat-timeline.

userId.description: The member. Absent for the whole-group entry.

avatarUrl.description: mxc URL of the member avatar.

nameAmbiguous.description: RoomMember.isNameAmbiguous, or another joined member has the same name after NameNormalizer (bipe#825). The handle line under the name already shows the @ of a Bipe user; a member with no handle line shows the Matrix ID after the name, as in timeline-rows. The pill keeps the name alone: the mention carries the user ID.

userId.description: The mentioned member. Absent for the whole group.

label.description: The text the pill shows: the name at the time of the mention.

isDm.description: RoomInfo.isDm (ADR 0141): no mention suggestions in a DM.

mentions.description: The mentions in text, in order.

suggestions.description: Shown while the word at the cursor starts with @ in a group. Empty hides the list.

mode.description: text: the field. recording: voice-recording replaces the field.

canSend.description: text is not blank after trimming. When false, the send button turns into the record button.

canPost.description: RoomPowerLevels.canOwnUserSendMessage for m.room.message and the person is not blocked (block-person), and the composer is not closed by publicationClosed. false: the composer is off, with the reason bar instead.

feedHandle.description: Empty when none. bipe-chat/bipe#1260, ADR 0280 point 7b. GET /v1/me/feed/rooms/{roomId} in a publication-only group on the main timeline, for an admin or moderator; empty otherwise or on any failure. Not empty: a line bipe_group_public_feed_composer above the field, and send posts a public copy first (action send).

publicationClosed.description: A publication-only group (group-privacy publicationOnly), the main timeline, and the user is below publicationOnly.minPostLevel of registries/group-power-levels.json (a creator is never below it). A thread view stays open. The message menu has no bipe_app_message_action_reply and no edit while true.

stickerSuggestions.description: The sticker strip above the field (ADR 0205). When text is one emoji or one word (see notes) and the setting chats.stickerSuggestions is on: the stickers that stickerMatches text, favourites first, then recents, then pack order, at most 12. Empty hides the strip.

appear.effect: Room.loadComposerDraft. A saved draft of type newMessage fills text; reply and edit drafts go back to message-reply and message-edit.

editText.effect: Sets text. In a group, a word at the cursor that starts with @ filters the members by name and @ into suggestions. Also runs typing-indicator draftChanged.

userId.description: The member, or absent for the whole group.

pickSuggestion.effect: Replaces the @word with a pill and adds it to mentions.

send.effect: messageEventContentFromMarkdown with the text, the pills written as matrix.to links to the user (https://matrix.to/#/@user:server), then withMentions (userIds of the pills, room true for the whole group), then Timeline.send. Clears text and mentions and runs Room.clearComposerDraft. With feedHandle and no reply, edit or thread (bipe-chat/bipe#1260): POST /v1/me/feed/posts with the plain text first; on failure keep the text and show bipe_group_public_feed_failed; on success Room.sendRaw m.room.message {msgtype m.text, body, publicationOnly.feedPostKey: {id, url}} (plain body, no formatting or pills), and when that send fails DELETE /v1/me/feed/posts/{id}. Deleting a message that carries feedPostKey also calls DELETE /v1/me/feed/posts/{id}; a failure there is silent.

leave.effect: When the chat closes or the app goes to the background: Room.saveComposerDraft with text (plain) when not blank, else Room.clearComposerDraft.

sendSuggestion.effect: sticker-picker send for that sticker, then clears text and mentions and runs Room.clearComposerDraft.

dismissSuggestions.effect: Hides the strip until text changes.

notes: Markdown, not rich text (client-rewrite-plan.md section 4; a Bipe rich-text composer is phase 3). The field shows plain text; the sent message carries the HTML that messageEventContentFromMarkdown makes. Bold, italic, strike, code and links render in the timeline.

Mentions (ADR 0141): groups only. A DM has no @ suggestions and no # room links. The whole-group entry shows only with RoomPowerLevels.canOwnUserTriggerRoomNotification. A mention of the user in a quiet group notifies (chat-notifications).

Drafts: one per chat, kept by the SDK on this device (ComposerDraft). The chat list row shows bipe_app_chat_list_draft with the draft text in place of the last message while a draft exists. Drafts do not sync across devices.

Windows (bipe#1346): use the same Room draft APIs in the account's encrypted SDK state store. Serialize/coalesce writes per account and room; drain accepted writes before releasing the client and encrypted-store key. A failed load must not become an empty editable draft. Preserve unsupported reply/edit/attachment drafts until those composer modes exist. Surface bipe_desktop_draft_load_error, bipe_desktop_draft_save_error or bipe_desktop_draft_unsupported. Keep a later edit, including an edit away and back to the same text, when an earlier SDK send succeeds. Clearing follows successful queue acceptance, not the send tap. Native restart/isolation/failure acceptance remains open; Mac features stay paused.
The send button and the record button share one place: canSend false shows record, true shows send.
canPost false: bipe_group_publication_only_bar when publicationClosed, bipe_dm_no_permission_to_post otherwise, or the block bar of block-person (bipe-chat/bipe#567) for a blocked person in a DM.
Replies and edits use this field with their bars (message-reply, message-edit, bipe-chat/bipe#559). The scam check runs only on received messages, never on the user's own text.

Sticker strip (ADR 0205): text after trimming is one emoji (stickerEmojiKey gives a key of stickerEmoji) or one word with no space that stickerQueryTags maps to a tag. Same search as sticker-picker, on the phone only. Not while replying or editing, and not with mentions in text.

MZ decision 2 Nov 2026 (bipe#958): the composer sits at the bottom of the screen and floats over the chat background and the scrolling messages. The attach button, the input and the send or record button are separate shapes: two 44 pt circles and a capsule between them. iOS 26 and later draw them in Liquid Glass (glassEffect, interactive); iOS 18 to 25 use the material blur; Android draws a raised surface with a hairline and a soft shadow. Send keeps the accent fill. The reply, edit and @ suggestion panel floats above the input in the same style. The bars that replace the composer (no permission, recording, blocked, left, selection, room upgrade) stay solid.
Hardware keyboard (bipe-chat/bipe#832): Enter sends when the send action is open, Shift+Enter makes a new line. The on-screen keyboard's return key keeps making a new line.

Notes (ADR 0053, mz, 5 November 2026): in the self-chat the composer has no sticker button, and the + menu is attachment-picker with its Notes rows. Text and the record button stay. The web has text, photos and videos, and a file, as in any chat.
